title: MongoDB Cloud - MongoDB Charts: Infinite login loop when creating new Charts projects
text:
Service: MongoDB Cloud
Incident: MongoDB Charts: Infinite login loop when creating new Charts projects
Status: resolved
Impact: minor
Started: 2026-10-02T00:01:48.113Z
Resolved: 2026-10-02T05:02:03.867Z
Updates:
- 2026-10-02T05:02:03.867Z: resolved - This incident has been resolved.
- 2026-10-02T00:01:48.239Z: identified - Since approximately 23:30 UTC on 2026-10-01, users creating new Charts projects by clicking on the "Visualization" tab will repeatedly be prompted to login and will not be able to view the Charts interface. While these Charts projects will be created, we cannot guarantee the timing at this moment.

Existing Charts projects are not affected.

incident.name: MongoDB Charts: Infinite login loop when creating new Charts projects

incident_updates.body:
Since approximately 23:30 UTC on 2026-10-01, users creating new Charts projects by clicking on the "Visualization" tab will repeatedly be prompted to login and will not be able to view the Charts interface. While these Charts projects will be created, we cannot guarantee the timing at this moment.

Existing Charts projects are not affected.

components.name: MongoDB Charts
components.description: MongoDB Charts is MongoDB's native visualization tool. It is tightly integrated into MongoDB Atlas.
